subject: AWS/GCP/Azure Marketplace private offer — unit price mapping & budget follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: James Li <jli@brightcart.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: AWS/GCP/Azure Marketplace private offer — unit price mapping & budget follow-up

Hi James —

Great to meet earlier. Quick recap and next steps so we’re aligned on the marketplace private offer path and unit pricing mapping for BrightCart’s PoC: 

Recap from today’s call:
- BrightCart needs a marketplace-private-offer workflow (AWS + optional GCP/Azure) for a customer-facing deployment in Q3.
- Primary use case: product search reranking + assistant generation for order support; estimated token mix ~70% prompt / 30% completion.
- Target latency SLOs will be met via dedicated instances; marketplace will handle billing via private offers.

Open items we need from you to map unit prices and complete a private offer: 
1) Monthly token volume estimates (rough band is fine): monthly average; peak Q3 expectation; 12-mo committed baseline.
2) Target unit price you need on marketplace (target $/1M tokens) or budget range for Cortex/LLM infrastructure.
3) Whether BrightCart expects any marketplace fees or margins to be absorbed (do you need Redwood to include a marketplace uplift in our private-offer unit price?).

Attached is a simple worksheet (redwood-marketplace-pricing-model.xlsx) that maps our list price to marketplace unit price targets; please fill in columns A-C with your token bands and preferred margins.

Suggested next steps:
- James to confirm token bands + target $/1M tokens by EOD Thu (4/15).
- We (Marissa + Aditya) will produce an initial unit-price mapping for AWS Private Offer and an alternate mapping for GCP/Azure marketplace flows.
- If numbers look good, we’ll produce a DocuSign private-offer template and coordinate marketplace onboarding steps with AWS Ops.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
(415) 555-0118

Attachment: redwood-marketplace-pricing-model.xlsx (spreadsheet — unit price mapping template)

From: James Li <jli@brightcart.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightcart.com
Date: 2027-04-12T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS/GCP/Azure Marketplace private offer — unit price mapping & budget follow-up

Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and the sheet. Quick answers inline: 

1) Token bands (monthly):
- Baseline: 50M tokens/mo
- Expected growth (Q3 peak): 150M tokens/mo
- Commit target for private offer: 12-mo commit of 60M tokens/mo average

2) Budget / target unit price:
- We’re targeting $800–$1,200 per 1M tokens (all-in marketplace unit price) to keep price parity with existing search infra TCO.

3) Marketplace fees: BrightCart expects a 10% marketplace fee on top of vendor price — we’d like Redwood to propose a vendor unit price that, after the marketplace fee, lands in our target band above.

I filled in the token bands in the sheet and attached a CSV with our month-by-month conservative estimate. Let me know if you need a more detailed projection.

Also cc’d procurement to start the private-offer paperwork/questions.

—James
James Li
Head of Cloud Partnerships, BrightCart
jli@brightcart.com

Attachment: brightcart-poc-token-estimates.csv

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: James Li <jli@brightcart.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-13T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS/GCP/Azure Marketplace private offer — unit price mapping & budget follow-up

Thanks James — that range is helpful. A few quick notes on mapping our vendor price to your target marketplace unit price: 

- Marketplace unit price = Vendor unit price + Marketplace fee (example: if vendor price is $1,000/1M and marketplace fee is 10%, buyer sees $1,100/1M).
- For your target buyer-facing band ($800–$1,200/1M), and an expected 10% marketplace fee, we’d need vendor prices roughly in the $727–$1,091/1M range.
- We’ll propose two tiers for the private offer:
  * Tier A (committed 12-mo baseline 60M/mo): vendor price $850/1M tokens (buyer sees $935/1M with 10% fee).
  * Tier B (burst/peak usage up to 150M/mo): vendor price $1,000/1M tokens (buyer sees $1,100/1M with 10% fee).

We’ll run the precise math in the attached model and share a final mapping for AWS Private Offer, plus variant tables for GCP/Azure marketplaces (they have slightly different fee structures).

Action items:
- Marissa: produce final unit price mapping and send to James + procurement by 4/14 EOD.
- James / procurement: confirm whether BrightCart wants Redwood to carry a portion of the marketplace fee or if they want the fee shown separately on billing.

Aditya
Director, Business Ops — Redwood Inference

From: procurement@brightcart.com
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, James Li <jli@brightcart.com>
Date: 2027-04-14T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS/GCP/Azure Marketplace private offer — unit price mapping & budget follow-up

Marissa / Aditya —

Procurement here. A couple of clarifications from our side: 
- We’ll accept the marketplace fee as a separate line item; BrightCart will not ask Redwood to absorb the fee.
- For contract approval we need a short note documenting invoices will be processed via AWS Marketplace private offer and that Redwood will honor the 12-month commit consumption baseline for discounted pricing.
- Please include a short technical appendix listing the expected billing unit ("1M tokens" defined as 1,000,000 tokens; detail on how tokens are counted across prompt/completion) so our finance team can reconcile.

We can move quickly on the DocuSign once the private-offer pricing table is finalized.

Thanks,
BrightCart Procurement

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: procurement@brightcart.com, James Li <jli@brightcart.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-14T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS/GCP/Azure Marketplace private offer — unit price mapping & budget follow-up

Thanks — noted. Attaching a brief appendix and the finalized pricing mapping for AWS Private Offer (see attached). Key points: 
- Final proposed vendor unit prices (AWS Private Offer):
  * Committed Tier (60M/mo baseline, 12-mo): vendor price = $850/1M tokens (buyer-facing $935/1M including 10% marketplace fee).
  * Peak/Burst Tier (up to 150M/mo): vendor price = $1,000/1M tokens (buyer-facing $1,100/1M including fee).
- We define 1M tokens = 1,000,000 tokens, counted as aggregate of prompt + completion tokens. We’ll include a sample invoice line to show how partial months and overage billing are handled.
- Attached: aws-private-offer-pricing.pdf (export of the pricing table), redwood-marketplace-pricing-model.xlsx (filled), aws-private-offer-steps.pdf (marketplace onboarding checklist).

Next steps:
- Procurement confirms acceptance of the two-tier mapping; we’ll generate a private-offer DocuSign and loop AWS Ops for onboarding.
- If accepted, target signing by 4/22 to hit Q3 onboarding timelines.

Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: aws-private-offer-pricing.pdf, redwood-marketplace-pricing-model.xlsx (final), aws-private-offer-steps.pdf
